crossRefs.note: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let…
Though men may rise up to pursue you, and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of…
Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David…
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

translations.web: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
translations.bsb: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
translations.kjv: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped
translations.asv: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But Jehovah helped me.
